notes.title: Neko Patch 1.0
notes.content:
Localization Fixes
We've addressed issues with character display for certain languages. Text should now render correctly across all supported languages.

 Achievements
Achievements are finally here!

 Audio Improvements
We’ve fine-tuned the volume and sound design in specific parts of the game to ensure a more balanced and immersive experience.

Thank you for your support and feedback — it really helps us make the game better.
Enjoy the game and have fun!
